verdict.rationale: Glama offers multi-model chat, document upload and an MCP gateway, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or a data-retention policy for AI models. The 'Private by default' claim covers listing visibility for hosted MCP servers, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
